messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Good news, Brian: order Shop····, the BSB NerdQaxe++, shipped July 15 and was delivered July 25. Tracking here if you want the detail: (tracking link hidden)

If the unit isn't in your hands or something's wrong with it, tell me and I'll sort it out.

Before you go, mind if I ask you a couple of quick questions? It really helps us.
Hello I am writing about my RMA for the order. The tracker says the return was confirmed delivered a while ago and I'm just checking in. (tracking link hidden)

Thanks Brian, that helps. I can see the order and that the NerdQaxe++ went out, but there's no RMA result recorded on it yet, and the return landing a couple of weeks ago is past our 10-day processing window. That's ours to fix, not yours to chase.

I've put it in front of the team with your order number and email. They're offline right now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.

One quick thing: was the unit ever overclocked?
Handed to the team · RMA return delivered weeks ago, nothing recorded on the order, past the 10-day p
That's with them now. Nothing else for you to send.
It was not overclocked beyond the listed 6.4TH abilities. It ran stock firmware, stock PSU, and it has never been modified, the heatsink was never removed.

Good, that's exactly what they need to know. Stock firmware, stock PSU, unopened heatsink, nothing modified, so warranty cover isn't in question here. I've added that to the note going to the team with your order.

They'll come back to you tomorrow from 10am ET at (email hidden) with where the RMA stands and what's next, replacement or otherwise.

Anything else on it while I'm here?
No this is it. Thank you for your help.
Happy to help, Brian. A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here, and you can reply to that if anything else comes up. The team picks the RMA up tomorrow from 10am ET.
